Name: NoisyFox's Quarry Cave Mine
Author: NoisyFox
Description:
Do you want access to a quarry area like the one on the hilltop farm but without taking up valuable crop and building space? Then this mod is for you! 

This mod replaces the default farm cave with a new cave that has an elevator which takes you down to a second floor that generates ore and other mine resource nodes daily, in the same way as the Hilltop Farm quarry area (exact nodes generated are dependent on mining level). This area could also be used to store big craftables or anything else the player wants.

You will need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url]﻿ for this mod to function (CP loads the maps, FTM handles ore generation).

This mod was heavily inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8582]Farm Cave Storage[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/46012122]BoogieBest[/url] so please give them some kudos. 

[b]To do list :

[/b]- Add configurable options for resource nodes to appear only on the left hand side of the entrance to the quarry, only the right, or on both sides. 

[b]Technical Note[/b]

I have made the second floor a seperate map from the main cave as having large empty areas on a farm cave map interferes with fruit bats working correctly, so this cave mod should work correctly for both mushrooms and fruit bats.
